blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. should reconsider his decision not to expel China’s envoy to the Philippines, several House lawmakers said Tuesday, renewing their call for the ambassador’s removal, saying he had “overstayed his welcome” after making a remark that suggested China could use force against the Philippines. The Philippines should “no longer host” Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan because of his conduct and statements that have blatantly disregarded the country’s sovereignty, said Senior Deputy Minority Leader and Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima, along with eight other lawmakers. “We call on the president to stand firm against further Chinese […]...
